title: How to Add an Affirmation Widget to Your iPhone Home Screen
description: Step-by-step guide to putting a daily affirmation widget on your iPhone Home Screen (iOS 17/18), choosing a size, and making it change through the day.
markdown:
# How to Add an Affirmation Widget to Your iPhone Home Screen

You look at your Home Screen dozens of times a day. Putting one short affirmation there means you read it without opening any app. This guide takes about one minute.

## What you need

- An iPhone on iOS 17 or later (iOS 16 works the same way for Home Screen widgets).
- The Anicca app, installed and opened once so the widget has words to show.

## Step by step

1. **Open Anicca once.** Answer the short questions so the app picks your first affirmation. The widget shows the same words the app chose for you.
2. **Go to your Home Screen and long-press an empty spot** until the icons start to jiggle.
3. **Tap "Edit" (top left), then "Add Widget".** On older iOS versions this is the "+" button.
4. **Search for "Anicca"** in the widget gallery.
5. **Swipe to pick a size.** Small fits one short line. Medium fits a longer affirmation and is the easiest to read at a glance.
6. **Tap "Add Widget",** drag it where your thumb lands most often (the bottom row is read most), then tap "Done".

## Make it work for you

- **Put it on your first page.** A widget on page three is a widget you never see.
- **Stack it with an app you open often.** Long-press the widget, drag it onto another widget of the same size to make a Smart Stack.
- **Keep the words short.** One sentence you believe beats a paragraph you skim.
- **Pair it with the Lock Screen.** If you also want the words before you unlock, see [How to Put an Affirmation on Your iPhone Lock Screen](https://aniccaai.com/lock-screen-affirmation-widget-iphone).

## Troubleshooting

- **The widget is blank:** open Anicca once, then wait a minute; iOS refreshes widgets on its own schedule.
- **Anicca is not in the gallery:** update the app from the App Store and restart your iPhone.
- **The text is too small:** switch from Small to Medium.

## Try it

Anicca is a free download with a 3-day trial for the full set of affirmations and reminders.

[Download Anicca on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6755129214?ct=seo-homescreen-howto)
